title: First Term Release Size Resolution
summary: Fixes the First Term release at twelve per cent of the remaining pool — 12.0000 of 100 units — slightly above the ten-per-cent default.

provisions.heading: Release
provisions.text: The release for the First Term is fixed at twelve per cent (0.12) of the remaining pool of 100 units, being 12.0000 units.

provisions.heading: Remainder
provisions.text: The remaining pool after this release is 88.0000 units, to be carried forward to the Second Term.

provisions.heading: Channels
provisions.text: The division of the release among the Endowment, Assembly, Deferral and Reserve channels is determined separately under the channel-split procedure.

provisions.heading: Review
provisions.text: The Assembly Bureau shall publish, at the close of the First Term, a statement of the claims released under this Resolution and their ledger stages.

history.action: Filed by Delegate Deneb, whose bloc holds one-tenth of the Assembly, as entitled to propose a release size.
Scheduled by the Bureau for the Week 3 floor.
Council window closed without delay or veto.

outcome.summary: 12.0000 units released; 88.0000 units carried forward. Channel division under [[DEMO-B-T1-002]].
